boss.victory_condition: Use the Wobble Key on the Chrono-Spider during its idle phase. This causes a chain reaction that damages it significantly. Repeat until health drops to 0. No combat required beyond the key use.

level.objective: Defeat all enemies and defeat the boss using only the Wobble Key. The player must learn the sequence of events and collect the Wobble Key from a prior encounter to stop the boss.
level.reward: A new weapon: 'Time-Whistle' — a more powerful version of the Sparkler Whip with a built-in time delay trigger. Also, unlocks the 'Whimsy Mode' for future levels.

level.setting: A floating archipelago of crystalline geodes suspended in zero-gravity drift. The structures glow with soft bioluminescent light, pulsing in rhythmic harmony. Distant auroral currents ripple across the void, and gravity fluctuates subtly, as if the planet itself is breathing. The atmosphere hums with low-frequency resonance—peaceful, ancient, and deeply serene.

encounters.location: The central geode field. The ground is a mosaic of shifting crystal plates, slowly rotating. The Graviton Bloom emerges when the player attempts to stabilize the field with a weak pulse.

enemy.name: Graviton Bloom
enemy.weakness: Tectonic Core Pulse (direct pulse over 8 seconds with 100% charge, targeting the core node at the center of its bloom pattern).

encounters.hazard: The terrain shifts every 45 seconds. If the player is not within 3 meters of the central node during the pulse, the ground collapses into a void zone.

pickup.name: Gravity Lens (Phase 1)
pickup.effect: Can be used to redirect a tectonic pulse to a specific point, reducing enemy damage by 30% when used in direct counter-pulse. Can only be used once per encounter. Requires precise timing and alignment with the core node's pulse phase.

encounters.trigger: After the player successfully completes the Graviton Bloom’s destruction using the Tectonic Core Pulse, the central geode splits, revealing a new path leading to a fractured bridge above. This bridge is unstable and only accessible when the Gravity Lens is active. Failure to complete the pulse results in a 20% health drain and terrain collapse, forcing the player to restart the encounter.

encounters.location: A fractured bridge suspended between two floating islands. The bridge is made of unstable crystal lattices. The Echo Tectonics appears during a gravity spike, manifesting as a shifting, shadowy mass of fractured tectonic nodes.

enemy.name: Echo Tectonics (Corrupted Bloom)
enemy.weakness: The player's own Tectonic Core Pulse used in reverse (called 'Reverse Pulse')—must be delivered within 2 seconds of enemy's gravity spike. Reverse Pulse disables its structural integrity for 5 seconds. Cannot be used if the Gravity Lens has not been acquired from the first encounter.

encounters.hazard: Gravity spikes every 30 seconds. During a spike, the bridge rotates unpredictably. If the player is not anchored to a node within 1 second, they float into a void.

pickup.name: Resonance Shard
pickup.effect: When combined with the Gravity Lens, activates a 'Harmonic Surge' that temporarily reverses gravity in a 10-meter radius for 3 seconds. Can only be used once during the encounter. Required to counter the Echo Tectonics' gravity spikes.

encounters.trigger: The player must defeat the Echo Tectonics using the Reverse Pulse. However, if they fail to activate the Reverse Pulse within 2 seconds of the gravity spike, the enemy grows stronger and the bridge destabilizes. Success triggers a central platform to rise from the floor of the lower archipelago—this is the path to the boss. Failure causes a chain collapse, resetting the encounter and draining 30 health. The Resonance Shard is only available upon successful completion of the previous encounter.

encounters.location: The central nexus—the heart of the archipelago. A massive, pulsing crystal lattice floats in the center. It is a sentient structure formed from the combined energy of the two prior enemies. The player must reach the core through a rotating platform, which aligns with the lens only at specific times.

enemy.name: The Lattice Core
enemy.weakness: The Gravity Lens must be placed at a specific 45° rotational angle within 3 seconds of the core's central pulse (emitted every 90 seconds). When placed, it emits a pulse that disrupts the lattice’s energy field for 10 seconds. The core will collapse if the lens is not placed during its active phase or if the player fails to align it properly.

encounters.hazard: The Lattice Core emits harmonic pulses every 90 seconds. If not properly aligned, the player is pulled into the lattice, which causes 30% health drain and disrupts all geomantic control. The core grows stronger with each missed alignment.

pickup.name: Gravity Lens (Final Form)
pickup.effect: Upon successful use during the final encounter, the lens stabilizes the player’s geomancy field. It becomes a permanent passive ability: reduces all geomantic energy drain by 50% and increases pulse duration by 20%. This pickup is *only* available if the player used the Gravity Lens from the first encounter during the second encounter and successfully completed the final alignment.

encounters.trigger: After the player defeats the Lattice Core using the Gravity Lens at the correct angle, the entire system stabilizes. The player gains the Gravity Lens (Final Form) pickup, which grants permanent geomantic efficiency. The level ends with a serene fade to white as the archipelago settles into stillness. If the player fails to use the lens at the correct angle during the core’s pulse, the system collapses, and the player must restart from the beginning with a 50% health reduction and loss of all prior pickups.

boss.name: The Lattice Core
boss.weakness: Requires the Gravity Lens (Phase 1) to be used during a specific 3-second window in the central pulse cycle (90 seconds from the start of the encounter). The lens must be physically placed at a 45° angle relative to the core's axis of rotation. If not used, the core begins absorbing geomantic energy, increasing damage by 30% per missed pulse.
boss.victory_condition: The player must successfully place the Gravity Lens at the correct angle during the core's central pulse phase. The core will collapse and the level ends successfully.

level.objective: Reach the central nexus and trigger the core’s collapse by aligning the Gravity Lens at the correct moment during its pulse cycle. Each encounter must be completed with precision to avoid cascading failure.
level.reward: Gravity Lens (Final Form) — A passive geomantic amplifier that enhances all future geomancy abilities and grants resistance to gravity-based attacks.
